title: Database JSON — import + export for notion-database
description: JSON import + export companion for notion-database. JsonActions ships a dropdown w/ Export + Import items. JsonImportDialog parses a previously-exported `.json` file (wire format v1: database schema + rows), diffs the incoming schema against existing db.properties (name + type match), then emits a single onImport callback containing {newProperties, rows, importedDb}. Result shape MIRRORS CsvImportResult — a single host handler can serve both CSV + JSON imports. Pure / props-driven. Lifted from notion-page-clone, simplified for the standalone slice (dropped AI assist, cover, blocks, sub-items, templates).

peers.reason: Reuses Database / Page / Property / PropertyValue / PropertyType / SelectOption / DatabaseViewConfig types.
